    bg=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(sum(gi,[]))-{bg}:
        cs={(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c}
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if (len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w) or (len(cc_)==1 and len(rs)==h):
            objs.append(('L',c,cs))
        else:
            objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    li=objs[0]; sh=objs[1]
    ltyp,_,lcs=li; sc,scs=sh
    lr_rows={i for i,_ in lcs}; lc_cols={j for _,j in lcs}
    if len(lr_rows)==1 and len(lc_cols)==h:   # vertical line, horizontal slide
        lv=next(iter(lr_rows)); scl=min(j for _,j in scs); scc=max(j for _,j in scs)
        nd=-1 if scl>lv else (1 if scc<lv else 0)
        steps = lv-scl if nd==-1 else scc-lv
        ns={(i,j+steps*nd) for i,j in scs}
        # side away from line: if line left, away side = right edge+1
        fc = max(j for _,j in ns)+1 if nd==-1 else min(j for _,j in ns)-1
    else:  # horizontal line, vertical slide
        lr=next(iter(lr_rows)); sr=min(i for i,_ in scs); smax=max(i for i,_ in scs)
        nd=-1 if sr>lr else (1 if smax<lr else 0)
        steps = sr-lr if nd==-1 else smax-lr
        ns={(i+steps*nd,j) for i,j in scs}
        fc = max(i for i,_ in ns)+1 if nd==-1 else min(i for i,_ in ns)-1
    if len(lr_rows)==1 and len(lc_cols)==h:
        for i in range(h): o[i][fc]=8
    else:
        for j in range(w): o[fc][j]=8
    return o

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); o=[r[:] for r in gi]
    bg=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(sum(gi,[]))-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if (len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w) or (len(cc_)==1 and len(rs)==h):
            objs.append(('L',c,cs))
        else:
            objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    li=objs[0]; sh=objs[1]
    ltyp,lcol,lcs=li; sc,scs=sh
    rowsL={i for i,_ in lcs}; colsL={j for _,j in lcs}
    horiz_line=(len(rowsL)==1 and len(colsL)==w)
    lr=next(iter(rowsL)); lv=next(iter(colsL))
    if horiz_line:   # line row lr; slide shape vertically toward it
        if max(i for i,_ in scs)>lr+1 or True:
            pass
        low=min(i for i,_ in scs); high=max(i for i,_ in scs)
        gap = (low == lr+1) or (high+1 == lr)
        if not gap:
            if low>lr: nd=-1
            else: nd=1
            shift = (lr-lower_bound:=0) 
            # slide until shape edge == lr+1 (below line) or lr-1 (above line)
            if low>lr:
                shift = lr - low + 1
                # move shape down by shift? shape starts below line: low = lr+k; want low'=lr+1 => shift = low-(lr+1)=k-1 upward
                shift = -(low-(lr+1))
            else:
                shift = (lr)-(high+1)   # move down
        ns={(i+shift,j) for i,j in scs}
        fc = max(i for i,_ in ns)+1 if min(i for i,_ in ns)>lr else min(i for i,_ in ns)-1
        for j in range(w): o[fc][j]=8
    else:             # vertical line col lv; slide horizontally
        scl=min(j for _,j in scs); scc=max(j for _,j in scs)
        gap = (scl==lv+1) or (scc+1==lv)
        if not gap:
            if scl>lv:
                shift = -(scl-(lv+1))
            else:
                shift = lv-scc-1
        ns={(i,j+shift) for i,j in scs}
        fc = max(j for _,j in ns)+1 if min(j for _,j in ns)>lv else min(j for _,j in ns)-1
        for i in range(h): o[i][fc]=8
    return o

allok=True
for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    fo=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ok = fo==go
    allok&=ok
    print(n,'match' if ok else 'MISMATCH')
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); o=[r[:] for r in gi]
    bg=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(sum(gi,[]))-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w:
            objs.append(('H',c,cs))
        elif len(rs)==h and len(cc_)==1:
            objs.append(('V',c,cs))
        else:
            objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    L,S=objs[0],objs[1]
    lcells=L[2]; scells=S[2]
    rowsL={i for i,_ in lcells}; colsL={j for _,j in lcells}
    if len(rowsL)==1 and len(colsL)==w:           # horizontal line row lv
        lv=next(iter(rowsL))
        lo=min(i for i,_ in scells); hi=max(i for i,_ in scells)
        if lo>lv+1: shift=-(lo-(lv+1))          # shape below line -> move up to touch
        elif hi+1<lv: shift=lv-hi-1             # shape above line -> move down
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i+shift,j) for i,j in scells}
        fc = max(i for i,_ in ns)+1 if min(i for i,_ in ns)>lv else min(i for i,_ in ns)-1
        for j in range(w): o[fc][j]=8
    else:   # vertical line col lv
        lv=next(iter(colsL))
        sl=min(j for _,j in scells); sh_=max(j for _,j in scells)
        if sl>lv+1: shift=-(sl-(lv+1))         # shape right of line -> move left
        elif sh_+1<lv: shift=lv-sh_-1          # shape left of line -> move right
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i,j+shift) for i,j in scells}
        fc = max(j for _,j in ns)+1 if min(j for _,j in ns)>lv else min(j for _,j in ns)-1
        for i in range(h): o[i][fc]=8
    return o

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); o=[r[:] for r in gi]
    cnt=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(cnt)-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w:
            objs.append(('H',c,cs))
        elif len(rs)==h and len(cc_)==1:
            objs.append(('V',c,cs))
        else:
            objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    line=None; shape=None
    for obj in objs:
        typ,*rest = obj
        if typ in ('H','V'): line=rest
        else: shape=rest
    lcells,linec=line; scells=shape
    if len({i for i,_ in lcells})==1 and len({j for _,j in lcells})==w:   # horizontal line row lv
        lv=next(iter({i for i,_ in lcells}))
        lo=min(i for i,_ in scells); hi=max(i for i,_ in scells)
        if lo>lv+1: shift=-(lo-(lv+1))
        elif hi+1<lv: shift=lv-hi-1
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i+shift,j) for i,j in scells}
        fc=max(i for i,_ in ns)+1 if min(i for i,_ in ns)>lv else min(i for i,_ in ns)-1
        for j in range(w): o[fc][j]=8
        for i,j in scells:
            if (i,j) not in ns: o[i][j]=bg
    else:   # vertical line col lv
        lv=next(iter({j for _,j in lcells}))
        sl=min(j for _,j in scells); sh_=max(j for _,j in scells)
        if sl>lv+1: shift=-(sl-(lv+1))
        elif sh_+1<lv: shift=lv-sh_-1
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i,j+shift) for i,j in scells}
        fc=max(j for _,j in ns)+1 if min(j for _,j in ns)>lv else min(j for _,j in ns)-1
        for i in range(h): o[i][fc]=8
        for i,j in scells:
            if (i,j) not in ns: o[i][j]=bg
    return o
allok=True
for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    fo=f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ok=fo==go; allok&=ok
    print(n,'match' if ok else 'MISMATCH')
print('ALL',allok)
out=f(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))

from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

    return G
G=load()
def f(gi):
    h,w=len(gi),len(gi[0]); o=[r[:] for r in gi]
    cnt=Counter(c for r in gi for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(cnt)-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w:
            objs.append(('H',c,cs))
        elif len(rs)==h and len(cc_)==1:
            objs.append(('V',c,cs))
        else:
            objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    L=next(obj for obj in objs if obj[0] in ('H','V'))
    S=next(obj for obj in objs if obj[0]=='S')
    lcells=L[2]; scells=S[2]
    if len({i for i,_ in lcells})==1 and len({j for _,j in lcells})==w:   # horizontal line row lv
        lv=next(iter({i for i,_ in lcells}))
        lo=min(i for i,_ in scells); hi=max(i for i,_ in scells)
        if lo>lv+1: shift=-(lo-(lv+1))
        elif hi+1<lv: shift=lv-hi-1
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i+shift,j) for i,j in scells}
        fc=max(i for i,_ in ns)+1 if min(i for i,_ in ns)>lv else min(i for i,_ in ns)-1
        for j in range(w): o[fc][j]=8
        for i,j in scells:
            if (i,j) not in ns: o[i][j]=bg
    else:   # vertical line col lv
        lv=next(iter({j for _,j in lcells}))
        sl=min(j for _,j in scells); sh_=max(j for _,j in scells)
        if sl>lv+1: shift=-(sl-(lv+1))
        elif sh_+1<lv: shift=lv-sh_-1
        else: shift=0
        ns={(i,j+shift) for i,j in scells}
        fc=max(j for _,j in ns)+1 if min(j for _,j in ns)>lv else min(j for _,j in ns)-1
        for i in range(h): o[i][fc]=8
        for i,j in scells:
            if (i,j) not in ns: o[i][j]=bg
    return o

    for c in set(cnt)-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(gi) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w: objs.append(('H',c,cs))
        elif len(rs)==h and len(cc_)==1: objs.append(('V',c,cs))
        else: objs.append(('S',c,cs))
    L=next(o for o in objs if o[0] in ('H','V')); S=next(o for o in objs if o[0]=='S')
    lcells,Lc=L[2],L[1]; scells=S[2]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')

for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows): G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for c in set(cnt)-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w: objs.append(('H',cs))
        elif len(cc_)==1 and len(rs)==h: objs.append(('V',cs))
        else: objs.append(('S',cs))
    L,S=objs[0],objs[1]
    sc=L[1]; sh=S[1]
    hv='h' if len({i for i,_ in sc})==1 else 'v'
    Li=next(iter({i for i,_ in sc})) if hv=='h' else next(iter({j for _,j in sc}))
    if hv=='h':
        lo=min(i for i,_ in sh); hi=max(i for i,_ in sh)
        if Li<lo: d=-1                       # shape below: move up
        elif Li>hi: d=1
        else: d=0
        shifted=[(i+d,j) for i,j in sh]
        nlo=nhi=min(max(i for i,_ in shifted)),max(max(i for i,_ in shifted))
        fc=nhi+1 if d==-1 else nlo-1
        skip=set(sh)
        out=[[g[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        for j in range(w):
            if fc<h and (fc,j) not in skip: out[fc][j]=8
    else:
        co=min(j for _,j in sh); ch=max(j for _,j in sh)
        if Li<co: d=-1
        elif Li>ch: d=1
        else: d=0
        shifted=[(i,j+d) for i,j in sh]
        nco,nch=min(j for _,j in shifted),max(j for _,j in shifted)
        fc=nch+1 if d==-1 else nco-1
        skip=set(sh)
        out=[r[:] for r in g]
        for i in range(h):
            if fc<w and (i,fc) not in skip: out[i][fc]=8
    return out

allok=all(f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] for n in range(1,9))
print('ALL MATCHES:', allok)

def objs2(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    res=[]
    for c in set(cnt)-{bg}:
        cs=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r_) if x==c]
        rs={i for i,_ in cs}; cc_={j for _,j in cs}
        tag=('H',cs) if len(rs)==1 and len(cc_)==w else ('V',cs) if len(cc_)==1 and len(rs)==h else ('S',cs)
        res.append(tag)
    return res,bg

from collections import Counter

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(c==2 for c in r)]
    objcells={(i,c) for i,r in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(r) if v not in (bg,2)}
    # line assumed a single full row; take top
    lr=line[0]
    top=min(i for i,_ in objcells)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for i,c in objcells:
        out[i- (lr-top)][c]=g[i][c]
    out[lr+1]=[8]*w
    return out

exp=f(D)
print(exp==O)
Tf=f(T)
for r in Tf: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
